notes.title: Dev diary #03: Mapping Kaodi’s Story Like a Metro Line
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]After the launch of [i]Kaodi[/i], we’ve seen that one of the aspects you’ve enjoyed the most is the narrative. That’s why we’ve decided to share how we designed the Inner World and the narrative progression in Barren’s journey 🍃[/p][p][/p][h1]Inner World Design[/h1][p]It didn’t take long for us to realize this would be quite a challenge—not just from an implementation standpoint, but also in terms of narrative coherence. What kind of system could we use to make sure we didn’t make mistakes in the progression of concepts? How could we create a balance between them so that some levels wouldn’t feel overloaded while others remained empty?[/p][p]Once we started writing the first drafts of the dialogues, we noticed the issue of not having designed the concept progression beforehand. We wanted each concept to matter equally, and it was essential to define what we wanted the player to reflect on with each one.[/p][p]We tested several systems that didn’t quite meet our needs, so we decided to create one from scratch—and it turned out to be the best decision we could’ve made![/p][p][/p][h1]The Concept Metro Map[/h1][p]That’s what we called it. Many members of Outlander Games live in the outskirts of Madrid, Spain, so it’s very common for us to interact daily with the Madrid Metro maps.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/a5e72aacb56a8fb6474b4e287eed248dbc8b6c2b.png"][/img][/p][p]We came up with the idea that each concept would be like a metro line, with its own specific color, and that the different interactions/updates of that concept would act as stations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/ab6c68917d30095d2014797a7f4f294113f37718.png"][/img][/p][p]This exercise helped us a lot when defining connections between concepts, identifying areas or NPCs with overloaded interactions, distributing the narrative weight across levels, and even spotting dynamics that we had not yet implemented in the Inner World code.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Want to see the result?[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🍃🍃Kaodi is now available on Steam🍃🍃[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325570/Kaodi/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary #02: Defining Kaodi’s art pipeline
notes.content:
🧵 Today we're revealing Kaodi's unique art direction journey. From day one, we wanted to create something that would stand out in the market. Here's how Jiale, our art director, didi it!👇

1️⃣ Our previous games like Nhiol (3D lowpoly) and Myth Tales (2D pixel art) gave us experience in different styles. But for Kaodi, we needed something fresh that helped us define our visual identity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/70ae3740465cd922792df56caf70de70d331394e.png[/img]

2️⃣ Recognizing our team's strengths and limitations, we searched for an approach that would allow us to create something distinctive and doable. 🔍

3️⃣ That's when we discovered 2.5D pixel art (or "low-spec"). This technique expands traditional pixel art by adding depth and dimension, bringing an extra layer of visual charm while staying within our technical comfort zone. 💡
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/6a398a0fe0c06db349baae9f24d26067e6c669ed.png[/img]
4️⃣ For KAODI's artistic direction, we drew inspiration from Eastern art, particularly Chinese ink paintings. This traditional art form's distinctive monochromatic style perfectly complements our game's themes and narrative. ⚔️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/9492fba23ad106623ac01f3ae6b5c5aecc768c26.png[/img]

5️⃣ Our technical pipeline uses Crocotile3D, a specialized software for creating 3D pixel art. This allows us to model in 3D while texturing in 2D pixel art—all in one program. Every asset follows a strict pixel grid to maintain visual coherence. 🖌️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/a1aaed912e7d4bad8c1b5ea8bb3c173f6ff50517.png[/img]
[b]Want to see how this unique art style comes together? Check out KAODI on Steam! [/b]🎮👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/33255[img]

notes.title: Dev Diary #01:Building Kaodi around an asset
notes.content:
🧵 Today, we’re telling you why Kaodi is the way it is. It all started with the incredible character design by [url=https://penusbmic.itch.io/sci-fi-character-pack-8]@penusbmic.[/url] 👇

1️⃣ This isn’t the first time we’ve used one of his assets. In Ronin Fighters, one of our earliest games, we already included the techno-samurai from the Sci-Fi Character Pack 8. We absolutely love their style! 🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/c0c2cda7db545d7f0bdc81e5dde3259d8a6d8f87.gif[/img]

2️⃣ Some time later, we saw he had released another pack, a clear evolution of the previous one. And there he was: an imposing samurai who challenged us to create a world, a story, and an art style around him. That’s how Kaodi was born, and the samurai became Barren, the protagonist of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/90d0d1cac464ecb89ef6939ed00875667afcb859.gif[/img]

3️⃣ But the original asset didn’t include all the animations we needed. That’s where @apoonto came in, completing the sprite sheet with walking, dashing, hurt, and a devastating new attack animation. The result was SPECTACULAR. 💥
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/5cbc867f53b8b2b2a45c2586b3a71641d569f145.gif[/img]
4️⃣ We wanted the spear-wielding version to be the game’s main enemy. For that, @apoonto stepped up again with new animations that made combat feel fluid, organic, and packed with the punch we were looking for. ⚔
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/46066299c4224a30d0cdf392f57d449a578b1922.gif[/img]
5️⃣ From there, our art team developed a visual style where Barren and the rest of the characters would fit naturally. Sometimes, inspiration for a game comes from the most unexpected places…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/9f40a4c6832c3a716b80273d7d735eb32d6aef97.gif[/img]
Want to see the final result? 🔥

Here’s the Kaodi Steam Page! 🎮

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325570/Kaodi/

notes.title: Kaodi opens its store on Steam! 🥷
notes.content:
Kaodi opens its store on Steam! 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309995/eb19a935308a2d1b81a938836b60d162a651582a.png[/img]

Explore the scars of war ⚔️ in this emotional 2D narrative adventure that will stay with you. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable story with Kaodi, a side-scrolling narrative game that blends action, emotion, and decisions that will shape the destiny of its characters.

In Kaodi, you’ll join Barren🥷, a soldier scarred by war, on his journey back home as he delves into his inner world and faces the deep echoes of a devastating conflict. This heartfelt story reveals how war leaves lasting marks on both the hearts of those involved and the world around them.

Throughout his journey🗺️, you’ll encounter unique characters offering diverse perspectives on devastation, weaving together stories of loss, dignity, and reconciliation. Additionally, Barren’s Inner World allows you to dive deep into his thoughts, interact with NPCs to unlock powerful stories, and complete missions that shape this one-of-a-kind experience.

Kaodi shines with its unique artistic style🎨, a perfect combination of traditional pixel art and modern 3D modeling techniques, all inspired by the elegance of Chinese ink. This visual approach redefines emotional storytelling in video games, making it an essential experience.

What makes Kaodi so special?

[list]
[] Unique artistic style: A fusion of pixel art and 3D modeling, inspired by Chinese ink.
[] Deep and thoughtful story📖: A narrative that will captivate you, exploring the consequences of war.
[*] Dynamic thought system: Make decisions that will shape the story and the fate of the characters.
[/list]

About Outlander Games
Based in Madrid, this independent studio was founded in 2019 by a group of talented university students who are passionate about creating memorable and creative experiences. Kaodi reflects their commitment to innovation and quality, taking players on an emotional journey through the power of video games.

🔥 Add it to your wishlist on Steam today and discover a title that promises to revolutionize interactive storytelling!

[previewyoutube=t6YDarXh_IM;full][/previewyoutube]

Kaodi is more than just a game; it’s a window into emotions, decisions, and reflections that will leave a lasting impression on how we experience storytelling in video games.
